rows.definition: One admitted slot of the dispatchtick EDFPlan: a DeadlineItem plus its simulated serial-lane timeline (PredictedStartTick, PredictedFinishTick) and a PredictedLate flag marking non-degradable items predicted to miss their deadline, which are retained and flagged rather than shed.
rows.distinction: It is the tick-level admission-ordering evidence for a serial dispatch lane, NOT modelroute's DispatchDecision (the ALLOW/REROUTE/DENY adjudication of a pre-dispatch payload residency check) nor the planner's ShedDecision (items dropped up front).

rows.definition: The adjudicated outcome of modelroute's pre-dispatch payload residency check: a DispatchAction (ALLOW/REROUTE/DENY) over Target/OriginalTarget with the classification evidence (Classified, ClassifiedBytes, TotalBytes, Matches, RulesEvaluated) that PayloadResidencyEnforcer records into the EgressWitness audit artifact.
rows.distinction: It is the egress-gate verdict on whether classified payload bytes may reach a remote model target, NOT dispatchtick's DispatchDecision (one admitted EDF slot carrying predicted start/finish ticks) nor guardroute's RouteDecision (the routing choice itself this verdict acts upon).

rows.definition: A field of ExpertRingEvictDecision: the incumbent LRU policy's GoodDecisionRatio scored against the same offline Belady oracle as the candidate, so the expert-ring eviction promotion gate argues in measured regret (#4233) rather than raw hit counts; expert_cache_telemetry derives BeladyRegret as 1 minus this ratio.
rows.distinction: It is the LRU half of the twin oracle ratios inside the ring eviction gate, NOT its sibling CandidateGoodDecisionRatio (the value-aware candidate's ratio) nor the derived BeladyRegret telemetry value that inverts it.

rows.definition: The per-request result of evaluating a Qwen38CanaryRequest against the certified MTP operational envelope: whether MTP runs default-on (CanaryDefaultOn, OptInActive), which engine is selected, whether the request is InsideEnvelope, and the DowngradeReason/CircuitTripped/RejectionReason fields when it is not.
rows.distinction: It is the live canary admission verdict produced by Qwen38MTPCanaryManager.EvaluateCanary and held by the agent InKernelPlanner, NOT the time-bounded Qwen38MTPCanaryReceipt that witnesses a finished campaign, nor the qwen38MTPTensorLayout the envelope's format prescribes.
